description: This script calculates random times to reboot a device, either within a default window or a maintenance window, and then sleeps until that time, simulating a reboot schedule. It also handles specific device types and logs crash events.

methods.name: calcRandTimetoReboot
methods.description: Calculates a random time to reboot within a default window, sleeps until that time, and logs the crash event.

methods.name: calcRandTimetoReboot_CBR
methods.description: Calculates a random time to reboot within a maintenance window, considering current time, and sleeps until that time, then logs the crash event.
